dedupe_keys.name: evidenca ladijskih dnevnikov racunalniski program inforib

description: Evidenca ladijskih dnevnikov (računalniški program InfoRib) is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MINISTRSTVO ZA KMETIJSTVO. Obligation of the Member State to collect data on fishing trips and catches of vessels of the Slovenian fishing fleet. The purpose is to report data to the European Commission and other Slovenian and international institutions. Coverage: MINISTRSTVO ZA KMETIJSTVO. The portal shows the English title as "Logbook records (InfoRib computer program)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is MINISTRSTVO ZA KMETIJSTVO. Its keywords include ladijski dnevnik, ribištvo, ribolov. The listing shows 2 download or service links in HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
